messages:
Oncall Bot: ALERT -> high error-rate on text-generation-prod (p50 latency up, 500s ramping). Paging oncall.
Alex R.: saw it, joining bridge now. what's the customer impact? any SSO or auth noise?
Maria T.: looks like model OOMs on a subset of requests when seq_len > 4096, some fallback to smaller model is triggering but with higher latency.
Sam J.: oncall here, I'm on the bridge. can someone post quick user-facing ack we can send to affected customers? need a short Zendesk macro.
CS Lead: yes - keep it short and empathetic. include expected next update ETA and a link to status page. avoid speculation on root cause.
Alex R.: draft macro below — please copy to Zendesk/Intercom. tweak tone as needed.

```text
Hi — thanks for reporting this. We’re aware of elevated errors and latency for text generation for some customers and are actively investigating. We’ve routed the issue to on-call and have opened an incident (INC-2026-042).

What we’re doing: our on-call team is applying a temporary routing rule to move affected requests to a stable model variant to restore availability.

ETA for next update: 30 minutes.

If you’re seeing any specific request IDs or examples, please reply here and we’ll prioritize.

We apologize for the disruption — we’ll follow up as soon as we have more details.

Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

Oncall Bot: incident created INC-2026-042 by Sam J. bridge: https://call.example/bridge/INC-2026-042

Jordan K.: status page blurb suggestion (short):

"We are investigating increased errors and latency for text generation. Some customers may see failed requests or slower responses. We are applying routing mitigations. Next update in ~30 minutes."

Sam J.: thread for internal exec update (concise):

- Impact: subset of production text-gen requests with seq_len > 4096 experiencing OOMs, causing 5xx and timeouts for ~8% of traffic in us-west-2.
- Mitigation: routing to stable model variant + temp lowering of max_seq_len for batching; rolling back a recent kernel change pushed ~45m ago.
- ETA for broader fix: 2-4 hours, monitoring.

Maria T.: quick troubleshooting checklist for support agents (copy/paste into macros):

1) Ask customer for a sample request id or snippet and whether seq_len > 4096.
2) Check request headers for model name and region.
3) If they are on hosted Redwood API, confirm tenant routing (dedicated vs shared).
4) If on Dedicated, escalate to Solutions with tenant id and logs.
5) Apply soft workaround: suggest client reduce max_tokens or chunk input until we confirm stable rollout.

CS Lead: good. add canned Intercom short reply for in-app messages:

```text
Short update: We’re aware of intermittent failures and slower responses for some text-generation requests. We’re applying a routing mitigation and expect a follow-up in ~30 minutes. Sorry for the disruption.
```

Alex R.: note for agents — how to mark ticket priority and tags:
- Priority: P1 for customer-facing outages with revenue impact; otherwise P2.
- Tags: incident:INC-2026-042, impacted:models, region:usw2

Ops Pager: accepting handoff. Sam J. please confirm: do we want to enable the permanent fallback for all customers or target only flagged tenants?

Sam J.: target flagged tenants first (to avoid cold-swap effects). rollout plan:
- 0-10m: enable routing for flagged tenants
- 10-30m: expand to broader sharing pool if no regressions
- 30-60m: monitor metrics, remove temporary throttles

Maria T.: logs to grab for escalation:
- `inference-errors-YYYYMMDD` (filter by model + request_id)
- system GPU OOM traces from nodes `gpu-*-usw2`
- kernel change diff: `deploys/2026-03-15/kernel-optim`

CS Lead: here's a short internal update template for comms channel #incident-updates (single-line updates so execs can skim):

`INC-2026-042 | Oncall engaged | Impact: ~8% gen traffic (usw2) | Mitigation: routing to stable model | Next: 30m`

Jordan K.: status page full update blurb for public (long):

```text
Title: Elevated errors and latency for text generation — under investigation

We are investigating increased errors and elevated latency affecting text generation requests in the us-west-2 region. Some requests that exceed a long sequence length threshold may fail with 5xx or timeout. Our on-call team has opened an incident and activated a routing mitigation to shift traffic to a stable model variant and reduce customer impact.

What you might see: failed requests or slower responses for certain long inputs.

What we’re doing: applying targeted routing to affected tenants, collecting logs and GPU traces, and rolling back a recent kernel change if confirmed causal.

Next update: ~30 minutes.

Affected components: Redwood API (text-generation), model-serving runtime (us-west-2)
```

Sam J.: tagging the Zendesk macro with the incident ID and link to status page now. Alex, Maria — please confirm when metrics show error-rate returning to baseline.

Alex R.: metrics trending down after routing enabled, 5xx rate from 8% -> 2.1% in last 7 minutes. will post a follow-up in 20.

CS Lead: when we post the first recovery notice to customers, use this short template:

```text
Update: We’ve applied a routing mitigation and are seeing error rates drop. Services are recovering; if you continue to see issues, please reply with request IDs and we’ll investigate.

Thanks for your patience — Redwood Support
```

Oncall Bot: status page update posted (https://status.redwood.example/INC-2026-042) at 1768004500.

Jordan K.: final note for agents — add `proactive_reachout:true` if you DM high-value customers with the recovery notice so support reporting can track outreach counts.

Sam J.: ok closing bridge in 45m if no regressions. great coordination everyone. :thumbsup:

Alex R.: copying these into a new support macro set: `inc-2026-042-ack`, `inc-2026-042-update`, `inc-2026-042-recovery`, `inc-2026-042-internal`. I'll push to macros repo after the incident.

CS Lead: thanks — wrap up checklist before close:
- Confirm error-rate stable for 30m
- Post recovery message to status page and customer channels
- Tag all related tickets with incident ID
- Postmortem owner assigned (Ops/Runtime)

Sam J.: assigning postmortem to Maria T. (will post links once ready).
